headline: Porr Shares Jump 5% as Nine-Month Revenue Hits Top End of 2026 Target
summary: Porr shares jumped 5% after the company reported that its nine-month revenue reached the top end of its 2026 full-year target range.
why: Porr is a major European construction and engineering firm whose revenue figures reflect broader trends in infrastructure and commercial building demand.

impacts.name: Porr
impacts.why: Nine-month revenue reached the upper end of company targets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Nine-month revenues hitting the top end of 2026 targets signaled robust operational execution and reassured investors.
